Oceana-URP

Imported from main on 2026-10-05.

Modified for PirateSlop, Unity 6000.6 and URP 17.6:
Scripts/OceanaRenderFeature.cs
Scripts/RenderPass/OceanaScrollPass.cs
Scripts/RenderPass/OceanaSurfacePass.cs
Shaders/WaterSurface.shader
Shaders/include/MapPacking.hlsl

Changes include Render Graph texture dependencies and binding, render target lifetime,
linear wave data, shared CPU/GPU wave sampling and time, geometric whirlpool and foam,
correct depth/refraction and above-water shading.
Editor utilities were moved from Scripts/Utility to Editor with their GUIDs preserved.
The original demonstration scene was omitted. New game adapters and test assets are separate.

Modified C# files are marked by a Modified for PirateSlop region.
Modified HLSL files are marked by a PIRATESLOP_MODIFIED_OCEANA define.
